# Third-party files

`DejaVu-Fonts-LICENSE.txt` applies to both bundled copies of `DejaVuSans.ttf` under the 2D sample asset folders. No SharpProspero SDK tree or binary and no supplied DualSense model is vendored here.

`SharpProspero-GPL-3.0-or-later.txt` is the license text accompanying the external dependency and the renderer sequence identified in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`; it is not an SDK source or binary.
